name: Pagination
description:
The pager that sits in a table's status bar. "1–25 of 1,284", the page size, first /
previous / page jump / next / last. It adapts to its own width (container queries): the
page size, then the jump field, then the first/last buttons fold away.
signature: ({ pageIndex, pageSize, pageRows, rowCount, pageSizes, onPageChange, onPageSizeChange, cursor, compact, label: labelProp, disabled: disabledProp, loading, locale: localeProp, className, ...rest }: PaginationProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: compact
props.description: One line: the range and previous/next only (short containers, card lists).

props.name: cursor
props.description: Cursor mode: next/previous only, no last page or page jump.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark, e.g. "Endpoint pages".

props.name: loading
props.description: First load: the range is a placeholder and the buttons wait.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the range and page numbers. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the zero-based index of the page the person asks for (first, previous, next, last or page jump); not used in cursor mode. Pair with `pageIndex` to control it.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Called with the rows-per-page the person picks from `pageSizes`. The page-size menu shows only when this is set, there are two or more choices and the pager is not compact. Pair with `pageSize`.

props.name: pageRows
props.description: Rows on the current page (the last page may be short).

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Total rows on the server; omit when unknown (cursor pages).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
